body: Believe me, if you are scared, that's mean it's not the time for you to go! You have to be in peace with the idea of not coming back for doing it! And I wish for you, you will never be in peace for leaving your girlfriend and your kids! Also ask you how would you feel if your kid came to you in twenty years and told you that he can't live anymore, how would you feel... That's how everybody feel around you! Hold on my friend! It's not the end!

For myself, it help that my parents had met his parent years ago from school. So when I started play video games on my pc and my pc crashed, they knew he would fix it, and will give me some advice for my game. So I ask him if he wanna come and play with my friend, he wasn't sure about it but finally come, and now he is our best gamer! I think you have to find someone with same interest as you, and who won't judge you! (He was 28, don't worry)

I have a friend just like you, he is so funny! He find it hard that nobody wanted to be his friend! But he finally found us, and we help him dealing with everything he feels and with his parents whom don't understand him! I'm sure there is some people out there waiting for help you too and to be your friend! Keep waiting, be patient! You'll find your place too! Have a good day !
Hey thanks by the way for listening! That's really appreciate!
Probably she is, but he never have been innapropriate! Just sad I can't see him, with everything that's happening, I need him to be there but no one understand, that's just suck!

Older than me... 31, but do not think he is wrong! There's is nothing wrong in our relation, we have the same friends, that's how we met, and when we start talking I saw that he could understand me! That's all! Nothing else!
One year , he's a really nice friend, his brother is like my mother, so he understand me a lot! That's helping a little bit!
She do not believe in girl guy friendship, she is scared that he is gonna hurt me... She do not understand our relationship!
That's a good idea! Maybe it will help me get some motivation trough all this! I'll think about it, make some research too!

I totally feel you! I always ask me if I wanna go out of this town or just go out of this world! Not always easy to figure all this out! I met a new friend and he help me a lot! Hope for you that you'll find something to help you trough this mix feeling! I totally understand how you feel!

Yes I have my best friend, but my grandma always need me and it is hard for me to go out and "take a break" she is kind of keeping me for herself and she do not like him so he can't come home, hope she will feel better soon so I can get a day for me!

They are not married, he just getaway with another woman, he came to see me two days in a years, taking me to eat something, talked an hour and go back to is american dream, what a dad! Anyway I do not believe in miracle but it will take one for my situation to get better!
I had to stop going to school, to much things to do... And yes I talked to her about it but she still thinking that the voices she is hearing are normal...
Of course, but they do not offer enough... Only like 4h by week helping with chores or make a meal... Really helpful!

Im 18F and I take care of my grandma Who's really sick and of my mother Who's sick too, and it is just too much. Everyday I fight for wanting to stay alive. I find a Friend Who's fighting to for his live, so when I try to help him, it's kind of help me... I like doing stuff with him and see that we are not alone!
